$comment: Single source of truth for routes, page structure, redirects, contact form and SEO. Copy lives in docs/content-brief.md and messages/*.json. Section ids are stable anchors and analytics keys; do not rename without owner approval.

sections.layout: Left-aligned text column (cols 1-7) over the scene, mountain framed on the right.
sections.rules: No eyebrow. No trust strip, no scroll cue. Must fit 1440x900 and 390x844.

sections.layout: Scroll-synced list: a sticky left column holds the section headline; on the right 4 capability blocks scroll past, the active one at full opacity and the others at text-subtle. Not cards.
content: 4 capability blocks: ai-agents, ai-solutions, automation, full-stack. Each: title, 1 sentence, 3 concrete examples as plain text, link to service page
sections.rules: CRM/Salesforce is NOT listed here; it has its own compact section later.

sections.layout: Horizontal 4-column timeline on desktop (single row, thin connecting hairline), vertical on mobile. Verb-led labels, no 'Step 1'.
content: 4 stages: Understand, Design, Build, Run. Each: verb label + 1-2 sentences

sections.layout: Full-bleed band, the camera is above the clouds here. Large framed product screenshot (real, demo data) with a short text block and link to the case study. This is the one place brand-blue may appear as a large surface (screenshot backdrop).
sections.rules: No fake UI. If the screenshot is missing, the section shows a labeled placeholder in dev and the production build fails.

sections.layout: Asymmetric bento, exactly 4 cells: one large (2x2) + three small. At least 2 cells with visual variation (a real architecture diagram image, a tinted surface, a code excerpt in Geist Mono).
content: 4 principles from content brief: privacy by design, multi-tenant isolation, reliable automation (idempotency, retries), human in the loop

sections.layout: Compact single-row band: one sentence + link to /services/crm-salesforce/. Quiet, secondary.
content: one sentence about CRM and Salesforce expertise

sections.layout: Latest 3 posts as a simple 3-row list with date and title (not cards), link to /blog/.
sections.rules: If the locale has fewer than 2 posts, hide this section.

sections.layout: Centered manifesto moment, the only centered section. Gold appears in the heading accent word or a thin gold rule, nowhere else. Stars ignite in the scene behind.

sections: 5 services as a 2-column list with large titles and one sentence each, ordered by positioning hierarchy

template: header: headline + lead (<= 30 words) + contact CTA
problems we solve: 3 concrete situations (text, no icons-in-circles)
what we build: 4-6 deliverables grouped in 2 columns
how we work on this: 3-4 sentences specific to the service
technology: stack chips in Geist Mono (plain text, no logos unless real SVGs from simple-icons)
related case study or post (only if one exists)
FAQ: 4-6 questions, native <details>, unique questions only
routes.crmSalesforce: Hub only. Existing Salesforce offering pages are linked from this page. They are not removed and not merged into this page.

routes.source: Existing service-page copy for that slug. Keep the substance. Restyle with the new site template.
routes.template: Same service template as the other services. Reached from the crm-salesforce hub, not from the primary nav.

sections: case study list (cards allowed: browsable items) with cover image, title, 1-line summary, tags
routes.rules: Only real projects. At launch: NoraMedi. Add more only when the owner provides them.

template: hero: title, one-line summary, meta row (role, services, stack, year, live link)
next case study or contact CTA

sections: tag filter (URL query param ?tag=, client-side, works without JS by showing all)

template: table of contents on wide screens (sticky, left)

sections: why PeakNova exists (name story: peak + nova)
what we believe about AI in operations
routes.rules: No team size, no team grid unless owner supplies photos and names.

sections: header (headline + one sentence on what happens next)
contact form (2/3 width) + side column: what to expect (reply within 2 business days, owner to confirm), email address

routes.rules: GDPR + KVKK. Owner/lawyer must review. Lists: controller, data collected via form, purpose, legal basis, retention, rights, contact.
Impressum / mentions légales. Requires owner input #2. Production build fails if placeholders remain.

redirects.$comment: Legacy URLs from the old peaknovas.com. ':locale' matches tr|en (and any other locale the old site served; owner to confirm). All are 301. gen-htaccess.ts compiles these to RewriteRules.
redirects.legacyBlogNote: Keep these slugs unchanged in /tr/blog/. English versions use their own slugs; ask the owner for the old /en/ slugs before launch.

fields.name: startedAt
fields.note: timestamp set on first interaction; server rejects submissions faster than 3 s

states: success (inline panel replaces form, aria-live polite, focus moved to it)
error-validation (inline per field, focus first error)
error-network (inline banner with retry, form data preserved)
